curation.name: Microduck Happy Hop
curation.summary: Short vertical two-foot hop for Microduck: stabilize in a standing pose, crouch, extend for takeoff, absorb the landing, then return toward HOME.
curation.details: Episodic one-shot policy with a 3.0 s nominal window and zero command block. The publisher contract requires a one-step (20 ms at 50 Hz) action delay, action scale 1.0, pass-through action low-pass, and a stable standing entry (trained from the Backlash walking policy after 1.0 s of exact-zero velocity command; not trained to take off from an active walking stride).
curation.notes: The package manifest is resolved and inspected; the registry records no independent hardware evidence. Publisher reports a successful physical MicroDuck test by Pollen Robotics on 2026-09-01 with the one-step action delay restored.

publisher_hardware.target: Microduck (BAM XL330, output-side Backlash encoder view)
publisher_hardware.note: Publisher reports the policy ran successfully on a physical MicroDuck after Pollen Robotics restored the required one-step action delay (tested 2026-09-01); validation video is published in the source repository.
